name: io.github.questdb/mcp-server-questdb
title: QuestDB Web Console MCP Server
description: Connects coding agents to a running QuestDB Web Console: notebook cells, SQL queries, and charts.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed WebSocket port for pairing. Auto-allocated when unset.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Log file location. Defaults to a timestamped file under /tmp/questdb-mcp-bridge.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity. DEBUG adds heartbeats and full tool payloads.
